contracts: Next-step generation is an explicit user action bound to the latest completed source turn. Official composer-predictions documentation states generation does not consume Codex usage or credits; sending the suggestion is billed normally. Account, model and regional availability remain subject to actual service results. Generation never automatically submits a turn.

Current-owner results are identified by predictionId/threadId/sourceTurnId and obtained by readback after identity-only mutation acceptance. Early events, old pending reads, stale sources, disconnect and unknown original receipts are handled explicitly.

Placement performs a fresh result read, then atomically inserts only into an empty current draft. A draft typed during the request or a changed source turn is preserved. Native unknown terminal state offers explicit service recovery.
At most 20 per-thread identities and 16 KiB result text per thread are retained in the current connection component; navigation preserves identities, disconnect clears them.
